{{Quote|You've failed me for the last time, commander. I will be better off without your services.|Darth Vader|<ref name="SW: EaW" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''officer''' served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. He participated in the search for a rogue [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kalast]], who had been feeding the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] with secret information concerning the newest Imperial [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. The commander was in charge of the Imperial forces during the attempt to uncover the traitor at the [[Assault on Thyferra|assault]] on [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]. However, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] soon arrived and assumed command of the commander's forces. Although the battle was won, Vader executed the commander for his incompetence in making sure that the Rebels were not alerted to the Empire's presence on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], which resulted in Vader's failure to find the traitor.

==Biography==
{{Quote|My Lord. We've located a small Rebel outpost using the nearby abandoned communications tower to receive Imperial transmissions.''"<br />"''Have the Rebels detected our presence?''"<br />"''No, my Lord. We jammed their communications and sensors before we landed.|The commander reports to Darth Vader|<ref name="SW: EaW" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="SW: EaW" /> At some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> it was discovered that a traitor was feeding the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] secret data concerning the latest Imperial project, the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. It was soon revealed that a clue to the identity of that traitor could be obtained from a Rebel base located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]. The commander was sent there to investigate. Before landing, the commander's forces jammed the Rebels' communications in order to take the enemy by surprise. After landing on the planet, the commander discovered that the Rebels were using an abandoned [[Communications array/Legends|communications array]] to receive [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] transmissions.<ref name="SW: EaW" />

[[File:ThyferraCommanderMeetsVader-EmpireAtWar.png|thumb|300px|The commander meets with Darth Vader.]]
Meanwhile, [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was personally tasked by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself with finding the traitor. The Dark Lord soon arrived on Thyferra in his personal [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. The commander reported to Vader on the mission's progress, and Darth Vader, taking the commander's forces, went on to destroy the Rebel base and find the rogue Imperial, while the commander remained at Vader's shuttle. During the [[Assault on Thyferra|battle]], however, Vader discovered that the Rebels had somehow been alerted to the Empire's presence. Despite the fact that the battle was won, the Dark Lord failed to find out who the traitor was. Vader confronted the commander near the shuttle and accused him of incompetence. The commander tried to explain that the traitor may have somehow been responsible for the Rebels' state of alert. Before he could finish, Vader used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|choke]] him to death. The commander's failure, however, was only a minor setback for Vader. The Dark Lord soon discovered that the traitor was [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kalast]] and captured him.<ref name="SW: EaW" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Your incompetence is troubling. The rebels were clearly alerted to our presence.''"<br />"''My lord, it is likely the traitor we are hunting may have [choke]&hellip;|Darth Vader and the commander, before the former kills the latter|<ref name="SW: EaW" />}}
When confronted by Lord Vader with charges of incompetence, the commander, a [[Color/Legends|light]]-skinned Human, tried to justify his failure by putting the blame on the traitor's interference.<ref name="SW: EaW" />

==Equipment==
The commander wore a traditional [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial officer's uniform]], complete with a [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] and chestplate with a commander's [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|insignia]].<ref name="SW: EaW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The commander was created for the [[Petroglyph]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'',<ref name="SW: EaW" /> released on [[February 16]], [[2006]].<ref name="This Week! Ep4">{{ThisWeek|6_nqmjRUuMo|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker Comes Home, the Child Lands at New York Toy Fair, and More!|sw_url=video/disneyxd-star-wars-the-rise-of-skywalker-comes-home-the-child-lands-at-new-york-toy-fair-and-more}}</ref> Prior to the game's release, he was pictured in a screenshot from the game within its [[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|strategy guide]], written by [[Michael Knight]]<ref name="EAW Guide">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> and released on [[February 14]] that year.<ref name="Amazon">{{Amazon|url=Star-Empire-Prima-Official-Guide/dp/0761551654|text=Star Wars Empire at War (Prima Official Game Guide)}}</ref>

The in-game model of [[Field Commander/Legends|Field Commander]] is used to represent this character. Additionally, he is subtitled as the "Imperial officer" in the game. [[Grant Albrecht]], [[Rupert Degas]], and [[Timothy Watson]] are credited as voicing "Imperial Officer 1," "Imperial Officer 2," and "Imperial Officer," respectively. Since there is no official indication as to which one of the officers is this one, it may have been either of the three. Although the events of the mission on Thyferra take place before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the commander is depicted as wearing<ref name="SW: EaW" /> the post&ndash;Battle of Yavin style commander's rank plate.<ref name="Imp Src">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>
